title: streams a reply and asks for permission in the browser
reason: The model answers in plain text instead of asking for permission, so the permission card never appears.

title: a host killed in the middle of a turn comes back with that turn ended, not left working
reason: The turn never reaches a tool call, so there is no mid-turn moment to kill the host at.

title: Cmd+R serves the UI as it is now; Cmd+Shift+R restarts the host in place, and a working agent continues afterwards
reason: The agent never starts a tool, so the turn is not still running across the restart.

title: switching profile while the agent works stops the turn, moves the session and continues it there, then sends the queue
reason: The turn ends before the profile switch, so there is no running turn to stop and move.

title: a message sent with Enter while Claude Code runs a tool joins the turn once the tool finishes, with its image; one sent the other way waits for the turn to end
reason: A message steered into a running tool leaves the page without its host connection; on the runner the model also skips the tool the steer waits for (vcs-vuuj).

title: a review opens full screen; the user tours the flow, moves through changes and findings, asks about lines, curates and posts the findings
reason: The model answers in text and never calls the review tool, so no review opens.

title: the agent rewords one comment in place: the user stays on the finding they were reading, and their choices stay
reason: The model never opens a review, so there is no comment for it to reword.

title: a script the agent starts, or anything with the agent's session, messages the conversation as the user would
reason: The model never runs the script it was asked to start, so the message never arrives.

title: questions elsewhere notify, in the browser or else through the desktop app while it listens
reason: The question in the other conversation never asks, so nothing notifies.

title: the sidebar marks the conversations waiting for you, in the look chosen in Settings
reason: The model skips the tool that gets the conversation into the state the sidebar marks.

title: Changes opens over a page, and a new page takes the canvas back
reason: The turn's checkpoint is gone by the time Changes opens, so it reads as if nothing changed and the Project section never appears.

title: workspaces and groups share one order: workspaces gather in groups that fold, land between groups, and stay in place when their group goes
reason: After a drop the sidebar's top level comes back empty on a loaded runner.

title: a message that joined the turn goes out again after Stop if the agent had not answered it yet
reason: A steer that joined a turn the Stop cancelled gets sent again and answered twice.

title: ! runs a command in the workspace folder, and its output goes to the agent with the next message unless dropped
reason: Stop misses Git Bash children that carry a stale parent pid, so the command's row never records the stop; this one fails on a Windows VM too.

title: a turn an API error ended is tried again from the error, and the agent still has the message it failed on
reason: The page reload right after a host restart aborted; seen once so far.
